transport.framing: buffered CRLF Content-Length framing with case-insensitive ASCII headers; strict overflow-checked decimal length with optional surrounding space/tab; identical duplicate lengths tolerated and conflicting duplicates rejected; optional application/vscode-jsonrpc Content-Type accepts UTF-8 or legacy utf8; only identity Content-Encoding is accepted
transport.failure: malformed headers, unsupported charset/encoding, conflicting/missing/truncated/oversized frames and terminal read/write errors cause controlled nonzero exits; a stalled stdout frame exits after its configured whole-frame deadline and is not followed by another frame; a zero-byte body is a complete frame and returns structured ParseError; clean EOF between frames exits 0

initialize.note: requires an InitializeParams.capabilities object; validates rootUri and every workspaceFolders entry before state mutation; an empty capabilities object is the valid minimal profile; successful initialize enters Running after its response

initialized.note: the first valid notification transitions Running to Initialized without a response; repeats and out-of-order notifications are ignored

shutdown.note: responds with null, then enters ShutdownRequested; later requests receive InvalidRequest and non-exit notifications are dropped

exit.note: exits 0 after shutdown and 1 otherwise; clean EOF between frames exits 0 as a separate transport rule

textDocument/didOpen.note: requires URI, nonempty languageId, signed document version, and source text; malformed metadata is ignored without opening a document; a duplicate open replaces the snapshot and starts a new internal generation even when the client version is reused

textDocument/didChange.note: incremental (2) + full replacements; multi-change lists applied in order; inverted ranges and lines beyond the current document reject the whole notification; character columns beyond a valid line clamp to its end per LSP 3.17 Position; duplicate consumed fields and mismatched optional deprecated rangeLength reject transactionally; rangeLength uses negotiated UTF-8-byte or UTF-16-code-unit units

workspace/didChangeConfiguration.note: accepts the standard settings envelope and applies only the validated namespaced elisa.analysisTimeoutMs setting; unknown settings are ignored and malformed values leave the prior value unchanged

textDocument/semanticTokens/full.note: exact source-occurrence coverage spans all 48 advertised categories; repeated enum/alias, contextual-binding, interpolation, and multiline regressions are also covered by focused token tests; full results map once through the session-negotiated legend and omit unsupported fallback categories

textDocument/hover.note: general hover from a retained analysis summary (declarations + param/local bindings) with loop-header fallback; A03 summary in flat storage

textDocument/didSave.note: intentionally ignored and not advertised; optional save text never replaces an open-buffer overlay or triggers analysis; disk-backed indexing must define save/watch invalidation first

textDocument/willSave.note: intentionally ignored and not advertised; does not mutate document state or trigger analysis

textDocument/documentSymbol.note: flat SymbolInformation by default; hierarchical DocumentSymbol when supported; compiler symbol rows nest under source-indented modules with block ranges and validated exact name selections where name_pos or one unambiguous lexer token proves them; struct fields and enum variants remain unavailable pending frontend positions/identities; symbolKind.valueSet respected

textDocument/definition.note: returns exact same-file locations for unqualified references resolved to one unique top-level function and for parameter/local BindingIds; nested shadowing follows identity; ambiguous top-level and unresolved references return null

textDocument/references.note: exact same-document locations for unique-function resolver edges and parameter/local BindingIds; includeDeclaration honored for logged declarations; unsupported, ambiguous, closed, or out-of-token queries return []

textDocument/documentHighlight.note: same-document Text/Read highlights for unique resolved function edges and exact parameter/local BindingIds; binding highlights omit kind until reads and writes are distinguished; unsupported, ambiguous, closed, and out-of-token queries return []

textDocument/completion.note: bounded same-file function/type/constant candidates plus exact-owner parameters and declaration-backed locals at function-body root indentation from the retained analysis cache; exact full-token text edits, prefix ranking, conservative string/comment/member declines, and honest isIncomplete=true; nested-scope locals, imports, members, and workspace candidates remain unsupported

completionItem/resolve.note: adds a detail string for one uniquely retained same-file function signature only when canonical URI, document version, and open-document generation still identify the ready snapshot; stale or invalid data is a no-op and all client-owned item fields are preserved

textDocument/signatureHelp.note: exact resolver-backed unique top-level source functions; nested token delimiters determine active parameter; named arguments, constructors, overloads, shadowed, member, qualified, dynamic, variadic, and synthetic effect-handler calls decline

textDocument/rename.note: advertised only when workspace.workspaceEdit.documentChanges is true; same-document parameter/local BindingIds only; exact compiler occurrence ranges become non-overlapping versioned documentChanges; new names must lex as Ident, include a parser-context disambiguator, and be absent anywhere in the source; no scratch re-analysis or cross-file rename

textDocument/prepareRename.note: advertised only when workspace.workspaceEdit.documentChanges is true; returns exact range and placeholder only for one unambiguous retained parameter/local BindingId; unsupported symbols or unnegotiated requests return null

$/cancelRequest.note: validated notification is ignored by synchronous dispatch; no active request can be observed while it runs, and unknown IDs never cancel a later request

$/elisa/stats.note: private request returning retained storage/document counters, cumulative frontend/accessor/index counters, and explicit transport/document/analysis/cache budget state; derived-cache cost includes retained reservations and whole-snapshot LRU eviction is reported; not advertised as a standard LSP capability

$/elisa/status.note: private safe self-description returning JSON-RPC/LSP compatibility, frontend contract and embedded compiler status, effective limits, and bounded logging configuration without reading workspace files or source text; not advertised as a standard LSP capability

textDocument/foldingRange.note: indentation regions + comment runs + doc blocks; line-only; rangeLimit honored

textDocument/selectionRange.note: word -> line -> enclosing indentation blocks -> document; strict containment; UTF-16/UTF-8 via Positions

textDocument/semanticTokens/range.note: filters and remaps the same cached full result using the session legend; re-encodes from document zero and skips unsupported fallback categories

semanticTokensProvider.legend: session-negotiated: stable 48 custom types for omitted/complete custom tokenTypes; otherwise a standard subset from docs/semantic-token-schema.json
semanticTokensProvider.tokenModifiers: session-negotiated standard subset: declaration, definition, readonly, modification; canonical cache bits are remapped at response time

completionProvider.client_capabilities: CompletionItemKind.valueSet, CompletionItem.snippetSupport, CompletionItem.insertReplaceSupport, CompletionItem.commitCharactersSupport, and CompletionItem.labelDetailsSupport are validated at initialize; optional item fields and InsertReplaceEdit are emitted only for capable clients
completionProvider.scope: same-file declarations, unique enum variants, and conservative exact-owner parameters/root locals from the retained semantic cache; results are explicitly incomplete
completionProvider.commit_characters: the opening parenthesis is attached only to plain function-name insertions when the token is not already followed by an opening parenthesis; it is omitted for snippets and unsupported clients
completionProvider.label_details: CompletionItem.labelDetails.detail contains parameter names for one uniquely retained function signature only; it is omitted for unsupported clients, non-functions, ambiguous signatures, or missing metadata
completionProvider.resolve: CompletionItem/resolve adds `detail` in the form name(parameter, ...) only for unique retained same-file function signatures. Completion items carry canonical URI, document version, and open-document generation in data; resolve requires the exact current ready snapshot. Missing, malformed, unknown, stale-version, or stale-generation data returns the submitted item unchanged, and all other client-owned fields are preserved. Resolve data is omitted for non-functions, missing signature metadata, or URIs longer than 2,048 bytes.
completionProvider.unsupported: imported names, members, nested-block locals, workspace candidates, snippets for overloads or signatures outside the retained unique-function index, documentation and return-type resolution, and multiline-string/f-string cursor context

definitionProvider.scope: unique top-level functions from exact compiler-resolved spans plus exact parameter/local BindingIds
definitionProvider.link_support: LocationLink[] is returned only when textDocument.definition.linkSupport is true; originSelectionRange and exact target token ranges use the negotiated encoding, and targetRange is the target token span until the resolver exposes enclosing declaration spans; other clients receive Location
definitionProvider.unsupported: overloaded or module-scoped top-level names, unsupported symbol categories, and unresolved identifiers return null

referencesProvider.scope: same-document locations for unique-function resolver edges and exact parameter/local BindingIds
referencesProvider.includeDeclaration: logged declarations are included only when ReferenceContext.includeDeclaration is true
referencesProvider.unsupported: cross-file search, overloads, module members, and unresolved identifiers return an empty array

renameProvider.scope: same-document parameters and locals selected through exact retained BindingIds
renameProvider.edits: versioned, non-overlapping TextDocumentEdit ranges in the negotiated UTF-8 or UTF-16 encoding
renameProvider.collisionPolicy: a different new spelling must not occur anywhere in the source snapshot; comments and strings can therefore cause conservative rejection
renameProvider.unsupported: plain lowercase words, top-level symbols, cross-file references, lexical-scope graph comparison, scratch re-analysis, and parser-context-sensitive names are declined

documentHighlightProvider.scope: Text/Read highlights for unique resolved function edges and exact parameter/local BindingIds; binding occurrence kind is omitted
documentHighlightProvider.unsupported: other symbol kinds, ambiguous targets, and unresolved identifiers return an empty array

positionEncoding.negotiated: utf-8 only when the client offers it first; otherwise UTF-16 (default, field omitted)

signatureHelpProvider.scope: one exact unqualified resolver edge to a unique non-constructor top-level function; returns declaration parameter names and one active signature
signatureHelpProvider.unsupported: named arguments, overloads, shadowed/unresolved names, module/member/dynamic calls, constructors, variadics, and synthetic effect-handler rewrites return null

textDocument.semanticTokens.tokenTypes.behavior: absent capability preserves the legacy custom legend; the complete 48-name custom list preserves its canonical order; otherwise the server selects advertised standard fallback types and omits unsupported categories
textDocument.semanticTokens.tokenTypes.validation: at most 256 unique nonempty strings, each at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; malformed types or duplicate decoded names/keys reject initialize with InvalidParams

publishDiagnostics.relatedInformation.behavior: emitted when the client advertises support and the compiler carries a secondary span

didChangeConfiguration.invalid_notification: ignored without changing the current setting

configuration.workspace_configuration_requests: not issued; no outbound request correlation or timeout is required yet

workspace_roots.behavior: initialize-time canonical workspace folders are reported in client order; document ownership selects the longest path-boundary match, including roots ending in slash; standalone ownership is the valid JSON integer -1
workspace_roots.compatibility: an empty workspaceFolders list falls back to legacy rootUri; clients restart the session when root membership changes because dynamic workspace-folder notifications are not advertised
workspace_roots.scope: root routing only; project configuration, cross-file resolution, and per-root semantic contexts are not implemented

uri_file_path.behavior: strictly decodes file URI authority/path percent escapes into an explicit POSIX or Windows absolute lexical path; accepts UTF-8 and spaces, maps Windows drives and UNC authorities, and rejects malformed escapes, NUL, URI metadata, relative paths, and unsupported POSIX remote authorities
uri_file_path.scope: conversion is pure and filesystem-independent: no dot-segment normalization, case folding, symlink resolution, existence check, or remote fetch; URI canonical lookup identity remains separate

filesystem_identity.behavior: the validation probe measures case sensitivity per temporary filesystem/volume and verifies symlink-to-target physical identity when supported; the current server never aliases open URIs from either observation
filesystem_identity.case_policy: a future resolver records sensitive, insensitive, or unknown from a filesystem query; it never infers behavior from the OS name, and unknown/missing/permission/unsupported results keep lexical entries distinct
filesystem_identity.symlink_policy: a future resolver may attach realpath/file-identity metadata for successful existing targets for read/index deduplication, while preserving lexical URI/edit identity; cycles, depth failures, and unresolved targets fail closed
filesystem_identity.scope: the shipped standalone server does no filesystem access; physical identity belongs to W02 project resolution

source_identity.behavior: the LSP analyzes the accepted physical snapshot through the expanded-unit compiler entry point with stable display name <elisa-lsp>; compiler #line display paths/numbers cannot replace URI identity or move diagnostics, semantic tokens, symbols, or hover ranges outside snapshot coordinates

lifecycle.initialized_notification: first notification transitions Running to Initialized once without a response; the server remains operational if it is omitted for compatibility
lifecycle.clean_eof: exit 0 between complete frames, independent of lifecycle state

legend.note: legacy clients that omit semanticTokens and clients that advertise the complete custom tokenTypes list retain the canonical 48-entry legend; other tokenTypes arrays negotiate a supported standard-only subset and both full/range data map through it

frontend_adapter.note: only module touching Semantic::SymbolTable storage layout; ref_kind roles named OCC_PARAM/OCC_LOCAL; exact occurrence spans are validated, while source-line-only zero-span sentinels use bounded token fallback; definition edges expose exact token spans

containment.incomplete_source: providers stay alive and recover after malformed edits; see test/incomplete_source_test.sh

diagnostic_codes.policy: generated from the pinned compiler enum; independent of wording and severity; unknown fallback is ELISA-Unknown; server-owned truncation hint uses ELISA-LSP-DiagnosticsTruncated

outgoing_range_validation.behavior: debug-only validation of provider ranges/folding spans, semantic-token bounds, request URI identity, encoding boundaries, and direct-array source order immediately before framing

unsupported_constructs.compiler_rejected: removed or invalid language spellings are probed against the compiler pinned by the build manifest and remain diagnostic passthrough cases
unsupported_constructs.lsp_provider_limits: compiler-accepted constructs that a provider cannot identify exactly remain explicit no-match cases; these entries are not compiler or server regressions
unsupported_constructs.triage: a changed compiler probe or compiler source fingerprint is frontend/toolchain drift; a provider golden failure with unchanged compiler provenance is an LSP regression

known_issues.policy: supported, experimental, and unavailable statuses are release-facing; unsupported features are not advertised
